title: Federation terminal attestation: exact first-event ordering and withdrawn-context retention under concurrent events and reconnect overlap
outcome: Federation terminal attestation: exact first-event ordering and withdrawn-context retention under concurrent events and reconnect overlap
acceptance: Under concurrent terminal events for the same link, and under an authenticated context replacement within one transport generation, the attestation projection retains the first terminal event of the affected context; deterministic regressions drive each interleaving from the grouped review-finding corpus.

When a context is withdrawn and a reconnect advances the transport generation before its terminal observation is published, the withdrawn context's terminal event remains observable (bounded, read-only) and is not attributed to the new context; a deterministic regression drives that overlap.
Existing owner/context fences, authority decisions, timers and routing behaviour remain unchanged; the candidate receives the standard independent review pair and exact-input validation.
